name: POCO Holding Co., Ltd.
summary: POCO Holding Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development of soft magnetic powder, soft magnetic powder cores, and chip inductors in Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and internationally. Its products and solutions are widely used in photovoltaic power generation, energy storage, new energy vehicles and charging piles, data centers, consumer electronics, intelligent driving, communication power supplies, variable frequency air conditioners, power quality improvement, rail transportation, and many other emerging fields, as well as carbon neutrality and semiconductor industry chain field. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
